rationale: The original thesis is fully intact: the +7.4% gap still holds above session VWAP ($31.81) with price pinned at 92% of range just two cents below the $31.97 trigger, five flat 1m bars with a 3bp spread show orderly absorption rather than distribution, and SPY weakness has moderated while no negative headline has emerged. Invalidation at $31.71 has not been approached and defines only ~$150 of risk on this size, so the position costs little to carry through the coil. Flipping short has no supporting evidence against a gap holding this strong, and closing would abandon an intact setup solely for time elapsed.
